item.title: One of Doctor Who's Best Episodes Just Got Removed, and Fans Aren't Happy
item.description: Following the publication of allegations of sexual misconduct against British actor David Walliams, the BBC has removed several episodes, comedy sketches, and films featuring him, including his appearance in the Doctor Who episode "The God Complex." Unsurprisingly, the move has left fans online seething.

item.title: Netflix's New "Carrie Meets Mean Girls" Thriller Is a Near-Perfect 8-Episode Binge
item.description: You should know if The Body is a show for you from the premise alone. After a botched dance-team initiation, a group of Catholic high school girls inspire a wave of mass hysteria in their small religious town — it may or may not be connected to the devil. Personally, it’s as if someone smushed all of my favorite keywords into one eight-episode Netflix series.

item.title: Disney's Legendary 218-Episode Sci-Fi Series Is the Perfect Anti-'Lanterns' Binge
item.description: The fate of Lanterns season 2, and the DC Universe in general, has never been murkier. With the sudden ousting of DC Studios' co-CEOs James Gunn and Peter Safran, the status of HBO's hit show series about two mismatched Green Lanterns who get paired together to solve an intergalactic mystery is up in the air like never before. Season 1 was a critical hit that captured the zeitgeist, and Lanterns co-creator Chris Mundy had already assembled a season 2 writers' room. But in a recent interview , Mundy said the odds of the series continuing were likely "50/50.”

item.title: 5 Funniest Quotes from 'Calvin and Hobbes’ Babysitter Rosalyn
item.description: To put it mildly, Calvin got on the nerves of a lot of people in Calvin and Hobbes . First off, there was his mother , who Calvin fought with over her terrible cooking and going to school in the morning. He also frustrated his father , particularly when Calvin would break something costly, like a pair of fancy binoculars or part of the family car. Calvin ticked off his neighbor Susie, too, and even his teacher, Miss Wormwood.

item.title: 10 Best Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave Replacements
item.description: It's been several weeks now since Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave was released for Nintendo Switch 2 , and fans around the world are still exploring this massive game. While you could easily sink hundreds of hours into playing through every Flame Lord's story, you may be wondering what to play after your adventures in Dagda are through. Worry not: we've compiled a list of games like Fortune's Weave to keep your strategic skills sharp while you wait for the story expansion DLC that's slated to be released sometime in 2027. While many of the games on this list are strategy RPGs, some incorporate other standout elements of Fortune's Weave , like its tournament-focused story or the opportunity to recruit dozens of allies.

item.title: PlayStation Officially Cancels Live-service Shooter Fairgames
item.description: Sony has canceled Fairgames (aka Fairgame$ ) three years after the live-service shooter was announced, Bloomberg reported on Tuesday. No one at its developer, Haven Studios, is getting laid off, and instead Haven will support other Sony Interactive Entertainment-owned studios, according to that report.

item.title: 4 Upcoming Fantasy RPGs Better Than Waiting for a New Dragon Age
item.description: The fire’s burning low. The road ahead looks grim. The companion who has spent half your journey needling you clearly has something on their mind, and you’re one or two correct dialogue choices away from getting them to spill. You pick a reply. You feel it land. Then somebody makes a joke about cheese, and the tension breaks.
